description: Choropleth: animals handed over per 1,000 km2 in each state (default), or the chosen animal group's share of each state's 2024 handovers, in fixed classes.

transform.calculate: (groupChoice == 'All animals' ? datum.per_1000_km2 : groupChoice == 'Mammals' ? datum.mammals / datum.total : groupChoice == 'Reptiles' ? datum.reptiles / datum.total : datum.birds / datum.total)
groupChoice == 'Mammals' ? datum.mammals : groupChoice == 'Reptiles' ? datum.reptiles : groupChoice == 'Birds' ? datum.birds : datum.total

groupChoice == 'All animals' ? (datum.share < 25 ? 0 : datum.share < 50 ? 1 : datum.share < 100 ? 2 : datum.share < 200 ? 3 : datum.share < 500 ? 4 : 5) : groupChoice == 'Reptiles' ? (datum.share < 0.5 ? 0 : datum.share < 0.9 ? 1 : datum.share < 0.93 ? 2 : datum.share < 0.96 ? 3 : datum.share < 0.98 ? 4 : 5) : groupChoice == 'Mammals' ? (datum.share < 0.02 ? 0 : datum.share < 0.04 ? 1 : datum.share < 0.07 ? 2 : datum.share < 0.1 ? 3 : datum.share < 0.25 ? 4 : 5) : (datum.share < 0.005 ? 0 : datum.share < 0.01 ? 1 : datum.share < 0.015 ? 2 : datum.share < 0.02 ? 3 : datum.share < 0.03 ? 4 : 5)

tooltip.expr: groupChoice == 'All animals' ? {'State': datum.name, 'Animals per 1,000 km²': format(datum.per_1000_km2, ',.0f'), 'Animals handed over': format(datum.total, ','), 'Land area (km²)': format(datum.area_km2, ',')} : groupChoice == 'Reptiles' ? {'State': datum.name, 'Share that were reptiles': format(datum.share, '.1%'), 'Reptiles handed over': format(datum.count, ','), 'All animals handed over': format(datum.total, ',')} : groupChoice == 'Mammals' ? {'State': datum.name, 'Share that were mammals': format(datum.share, '.1%'), 'Mammals handed over': format(datum.count, ','), 'All animals handed over': format(datum.total, ',')} : {'State': datum.name, 'Share that were birds': format(datum.share, '.1%'), 'Birds handed over': format(datum.count, ','), 'All animals handed over': format(datum.total, ',')}
